title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 Full Length Mock Test 05 (Hard Level)
description: Hard Level Full Length Mock Test for SSC CHSL Tier-1. 100 Questions | 60 Minutes | Reasoning 25, GA 25, Quant 25, English 25.
instructions: Yeh Hard Level Full Length Mock Test hai.
Total 100 questions: Reasoning 25, General Awareness 25, Quantitative Aptitude 25, English 25.
Har question 2 marks ka hai. Galat jawab par 0.5 marks katenge.
SSC CHSL Tier-1 latest pattern ke anusar.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: Pen : Write :: Knife : ?
questions.explanation: Pen is used to write; knife is used to cut.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: Find the missing term: 2, 6, 12, 20, 30, ?

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: If PAPER is coded as QBQFS, how is PENCIL coded?
questions.explanation: Each letter +1: P-E-N-C-I-L becomes Q-F-O-D-J-M.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: Pointing to a photograph, a man said, 'She is the daughter of my grandfather's only son.' How is the girl related to the man?
questions.explanation: Grandfather's only son is the man's father; that father's daughter is the man's sister.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: A man walks 5 km North, then 3 km East, then 5 km South. How far is he from the starting point?
questions.explanation: North and South cancel; he is 3 km East of start.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: Statements: All books are pens. Some pens are pencils. Conclusions: I. Some books are pencils. II. Some pens are books.
questions.explanation: All books are pens implies some pens are books. I is not definite.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: Find the odd one: 121, 144, 169, 196, 218, 256
questions.explanation: All others are perfect squares; 218 is not.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: Find the next: AZ, BY, CX, DW, ?
questions.explanation: First letters A-B-C-D-E and second Z-Y-X-W-V.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: If 15 August 2024 was Thursday, what day was 15 August 2025?
questions.explanation: From Aug 2024 to Aug 2025 no extra leap day after August, so +1 weekday.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: At what time between 3 and 4 o'clock are the hands of a clock together?
questions.explanation: Hands coincide at 16 4/11 minutes past 3.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: In a row of 40 students, A is 12th from the left and B is 9th from the right. How many students are between A and B?
questions.explanation: B is 32nd from left; between = 32-12-1 = 19.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: Five friends P,Q,R,S,T sit in a row. P is to the left of Q. R is between Q and S. T is at the extreme right. Who is at the extreme left?
questions.explanation: Order is P Q R S T, so P is extreme left.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: Statement: All that glitters is not gold. Conclusions: I. Gold does not glitter. II. Some glittering things are not gold.
questions.explanation: The saying means some glittering things are not gold.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: If the word CHSL is seen in a mirror placed to the right, which letter appears first from the left in the reversed order?
questions.explanation: Left-right reversal gives LSHC.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: Which diagram best represents Doctors, Males and Engineers?
questions.explanation: A person can belong to any combination of the three sets.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: If + means x, x means -, - means /, / means +, then 8 + 4 x 2 - 2 / 6 = ?

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: A triangle with midpoints joined forms how many smallest triangles?
questions.explanation: Joining midpoints divides a triangle into 4 congruent small triangles.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: A square paper is folded once vertically and a hole is punched at the centre of the folded sheet. How many holes appear when unfolded?
questions.explanation: One fold creates two layers, hence two holes.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: On a standard dice, if 1 is opposite 6 and 2 is opposite 5, what is opposite 3?
questions.explanation: Opposite faces of a standard dice sum to 7.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: A, B, C, D, E sit facing the centre of a circle. A is to the right of B. C is between A and D. E is immediately to the left of B. Who sits between B and E?
questions.explanation: E and B are adjacent, so nobody sits between them.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: If P > Q >= R = S < T, which is definitely true?
questions.explanation: P is greater than Q which is at least R which equals S, so P > S.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: ACE : FHJ :: KMO : ?
questions.explanation: Each letter moves +5 places: KMO becomes PRT.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: 3 5 7 / 4 6 8 / 5 7 ?  Find ?
questions.explanation: Each row increases by 2 across columns.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: Statement: Use our fertiliser for double yield. Assumptions: I. Farmers want higher yield. II. The fertiliser is expensive.
questions.explanation: The claim assumes farmers desire more yield; price is not assumed.

questions.subject: General Awareness

questions.subject: General Awareness
questions.question: GST was implemented in India from?

questions.subject: General Awareness

questions.explanation: Army Headquarters is in New Delhi.

questions.subject: General Awareness
questions.question: Vitamin C is also known as?

questions.subject: General Awareness
questions.question: Madhubani painting originated in which state?
questions.explanation: Madhubani or Mithila painting originated in Bihar.

questions.question: The powerhouse of the cell is?

options: The house was built by them.
The house is built by them.
